photos.desc: Introduced warm-season perennial large C4 grass; stems grow to 200 cm tall and arise from long stout rhizomes. Leaves are broad, with distinctive white midribs. Leaf sheaths and nodes are hairless. Fl
Flowerheads are large open panicles 25-45 cm long. Spikelets are paired (lower awned, upper unawned), 4-6 mm long and 2-flowered; often red/brown on one side and green on the other.
